In this context, the CNES CSG aims to deliver a new data-sharing platform that could be used by all industrial partners over the Space Centre.
Currently the data sharing in between industrial is complicated. We need a platform that could ensure the security and the sharing of data set that will allow to cover specific use cases such as Supply chain, energy consumptions.
